subject.title: [Bug]: Feishu plugin send message fails with 400 error - receive_id_type is required

question: Should maintainers revive the linked fork PR, replace it with a narrow in-repo fix, or close that candidate before queueing work for this issue?
rationale: The issue has a source-supported remaining bug and an open conflicting fork PR with closing syntax, so automation should not create competing work until the owner path is chosen.

options.title: Replace with a narrow in-repo fix
options.body: Open or sponsor a fresh focused fix on current main that guards invalid Feishu targets, preserves valid routes, adds tests, and obtains live proof if credentials are available.

options.title: Revive the fork PR
options.body: Ask the fork PR author or a maintainer to rebase, address the prior type/review concerns, add tests, and provide real Feishu/Lark proof before merge consideration.

options.title: Wait for live reproduction
options.body: Keep the issue in maintainer review and ask for redacted logs or a live Feishu repro before committing to a code change.

recommendation.title: Replace with a narrow in-repo fix
recommendation.body: Open or sponsor a fresh focused fix on current main that guards invalid Feishu targets, preserves valid routes, adds tests, and obtains live proof if credentials are available.

likelyOwner.reason: The package metadata names this handle as the Feishu/Lark plugin community maintainer, which makes them the best available owner for the receive-id routing decision.
